items.title: Moody’s and S&P downgrade Akamai on debt-fueled AI infrastructure buildout
items.summary: Investing.com -- Akamai Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:AKAM) saw its credit profile take a significant hit on Monday as both Moody’s Ratings and S&P Global Ratings downgraded the company following its decision to raise over $2 billion in convertible debt to pre-fund an aggressive push into artificial intelligence edge infrastructure. items.title: AKAM Q3 2026 deep dive: cloud infrastructure contracts expand as near-term guidance softens
items.summary: Cloud technology company Akamai Technologies (NASDAQ:AKAM) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 6.4% year on year to $1.12 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $1.16 billion was less impressive, coming in 3.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.77 per share was 5.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
